meta.title: Pinch: Recipe Library | Save Recipes from TikTok, Instagram & YouTube
meta.description: Pinch is a recipe keeper app that turns TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube cooking videos into written recipes, with ingredients, steps, and a shopping list. It reads the whole video, not just the caption.
meta.ogDescription: Turn a cooking video into ingredients, steps, and a shopping list.
meta.ogImageAlt: Pinch: a TikTok pasta video turned into a saved recipe card. Saw it on TikTok? Now it's dinner.
meta.appDescription: Pinch is a recipe keeper app that turns TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube cooking videos into written recipes, with ingredients, steps, and a shopping list.
meta.disambiguation: The recipe app at pinch-app.io that turns TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube cooking videos into written recipes. Listed as Pinch: Recipe Library on the App Store and Google Play. Not related to other apps or sites named Pinch.

features.title: A recipe organizer for the videos you cook from
features.sub: The recipe, the list, and the video, kept in one kitchen.

items.title: Save TikTok and Instagram recipes
items.text: Share a TikTok or an Instagram Reel to Pinch, or paste the link yourself.

items.title: YouTube video to recipe
items.text: Get the ingredients and steps written out. No more pausing and rewinding.

items.title: The whole recipe, every time
items.text: Even when the amounts are only said out loud or flashed on screen, Pinch writes them down.

items.title: Cook along
items.text: Keep the source video beside the steps, or follow a step-by-step cook mode with timers.

items.title: A shopping list that knows your pantry
items.text: Ingredients from several recipes stack into one line, grouped by aisle. Staples you always have stay off.

items.title: What's in the fridge?
items.text: Snap your fridge and Pinch ranks the recipes you already saved by what you have.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Remix any recipe (healthier, vegetarian, gluten-free, and more), swap an ingredient, scale servings, or translate it.

items.title: Websites and cookbooks too
items.text: Paste a recipe website link, or snap a cookbook page or a handwritten card.

items.title: Your recipe library
items.text: Keep every saved recipe in one place and group them for dinner, baking, or easy weeknights.

how.title: How to save a recipe from a video
how.sub: From a video in your feed to a list in your hand.

steps.title: Share the video
steps.text: Tap Share on a TikTok, Instagram Reel, or YouTube video and pick Pinch. Or copy the link and paste it in.

steps.title: Get the recipe
steps.text: Pinch's AI writes out the ingredients and steps, even the ones only said out loud or shown on screen.

steps.title: Shop the list
steps.text: The ingredients go on one shopping list, grouped by aisle. Check them off at the store.

items.a: Pinch reads a cooking video from TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube and turns it into a written recipe: ingredients, steps, and a shopping list you can check off at the store.

items.q: Is this the same as other apps called Pinch?
items.a: No. This is Pinch: Recipe Library, the app at pinch-app.io, on the App Store and Google Play. It isn't related to other apps or sites with Pinch in the name, such as getpinch.io or the Pinch It! Recipe Box app.

items.q: Can Pinch turn a YouTube video into a recipe?
items.a: Yes. Paste a YouTube link and Pinch's AI recipe extractor writes out the ingredients and steps, so you don't have to pause and rewind while you cook.

items.q: How do I save a recipe from TikTok or Instagram?
items.a: Tap Share on the video and pick Pinch, or copy the link and paste it into Pinch. Preview the recipe, then tap save to keep it in your library.
Yes. A free account includes 10 recipe credits every month. If you need more, you can buy recipe credits in the app. They never expire, and there's no subscription.

items.q: Can I use Pinch without the app?
items.a: Yes. Pinch also runs in your browser at [pinch-app.io/app](/app/). Your library syncs when you sign in with the same account.

items.q: Can I move my recipes from another app?
items.a: Yes, one recipe at a time. Paste the original link, from a website or a video, and Pinch saves it to your library.
Pinch is available in English, Spanish, Hebrew, Arabic, and Russian.
No. Pinch doesn't sell your personal information. The services that help run Pinch, like the AI that writes out your recipes, only process it to operate Pinch.
